title: DV-SLAM RA-L Paper Rewrite
description: Rewrite IEEE RA-L paper to align with confirmed direction: sparse dToF LIO (not confidence-aware), multi-sensor tight coupling (not camera-free), confidence demoted to ablation. 6+2 page format.

acceptanceCriteria: Title changed: remove 'Confidence-Aware' and 'camera-free', focus on 'Sparse Mobile dToF' and 'On-Device LIO'
Abstract: leads with sparse dToF regime problem (<500 pts), NOT confidence
Abstract: mentions camera+LiDAR+IMU tight coupling, NOT camera-free
Abstract: confidence mentioned only as 'ablation shows modest improvement'
Abstract: mentions ScanNet++ evaluation and collapse boundary
Introduction P1-P3: dense LIO gap -> dToF regime qualitatively different (keep F1-F3)
Introduction P4-P5: thesis = 'lightweight on-device LIO architecture enables sparse regime' NOT 'confidence is key enabler'

Contributions rewritten: C1=First on-device LIO for sparse dToF, C2=Sparse-regime characterization (collapse boundary), C3=Lightweight mobile LIO architecture (ikd-tree->voxel hash, stride sampling, Eigen-only)
No 'camera-free' claim anywhere in abstract or intro
Confidence NOT listed as a contribution, only mentioned as system component
Propositions 1-2 (54% variance inflation) references REMOVED from contributions
Keywords updated to match new framing

stories.title: Method section rewrite
acceptanceCriteria: Section 3 overview: 3-sensor pipeline (dToF + Camera + IMU -> ESKF), NOT camera-free
Section 3.1 Depth Back-Projection: keep as-is (correct), remove camera-free claim
Section 3.2 Bundle & Discard (renamed from CGD): voxel spatial hashing, density+confidence gates, centroid emission. Remove Lemma about information loss
Section 3.3 IEKF State Estimation: 18D state, midpoint IMU integration, static init from gravity. Keep equations
Section 3.4 Point-to-Plane ICP: point-to-plane residual, TLS robust kernel, confidence weighting as R_obs scaling (1 paragraph, not prominent). Remove Propositions 1-2 entirely
NEW Section 3.5 Visual Feature Tracking: Shi-Tomasi + Pyramidal KLT, feature 3D init from dToF depth (no stereo needed), reprojection residual in ESKF. Brief (standard method)
NEW Section 3.6 Multi-Sensor ESKF Update: depth ICP residuals + visual reprojection residuals, sequential update structure. Honest about sequential vs joint optimization
Section 3.7 Robustness: map seeding (5 frames), correction clamping, non-convergence rejection, velocity clamp, ICP failure recovery
Section 3.8 Map Management: voxel hash map (O(1) insert, 5x5x5 KNN), LRU eviction (500K cap). Contrast with ikd-tree
Remove ALL Propositions (Prop 1, Prop 2) and Lemma (CGD information bound)
Remove ALL 'camera-free' claims
All equations numbered and referenced correctly
LaTeX compiles without errors

stories.title: Discussion + Conclusion + References
acceptanceCriteria: Discussion 7.1: sparse regime tight coupling importance (references ablation results)
Discussion 7.2: confidence is modest improvement (references ablation, honest assessment)
Discussion 7.3: platform portability — ARKit = sensor HAL, algorithm portable to Android/ROS
Limitations: no loop closure, dense LiDAR accuracy gap, velocity clamp 0.5m/s, single platform evaluation
Future work: loop closure, learned depth completion, multi-device evaluation
